newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Oct 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Oct 28.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Defence Minister Prince Sultan signs 597.7-million-riyal contract for the operation and maintenance of the kingdom's civil aviation system.
- Trade exchanges between Saudi Arabia and Germany stood at 3.73 billion riyals during the first half of 1996.
- Mubrad Saudi transportation company reduced its losses to 270,000 riyals in the first nine months of 1996.
- Meridien Hotel in Al-Khobar signs a 33-million-riyal contract for the renovation of the hotel.
